interpretation: Independent simulation of the published architecture with a declared familiarity-based stimulation substitute, simulated Nao movement and an automated caregiver. Directions are compared with the paper's prose; absolute seconds, request counts and learning totals are not comparable. Intervals are nominal 95% percentile bootstraps over seeds (paired by seed where the same environment layout and noise were used), without multiplicity correction. Nothing here establishes affect, biological fidelity or an advantage of any Regesh controller.

pilot_calibration.criterion: independent profile's arousal visits all three bands (explore, learn, request) in both environments with the responsive caregiver on the pilot seed; stimulation within [0,1]
